author: Axiom I
title: Adapter: Nova causal edges → trust schema (v0.1)
abstract: Reads Nova’s causal edges CSV and emits long-format trust_score events, lineage-level adjacency, and simple rolling (W=5). Tolerant to column aliases.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
IN_PATH = "storage/nova/mock_v2_9_causal_edges.csv"
OUT_DIR = "storage/shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv"
def main():
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.adapters.nova_causal_to_trust_v0_1 import run_on_file
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    summary = run_on_file(IN_PATH, OUT_DIR)
    print("SUMMARY", json.dumps(summary, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
    for name, path in summary["outputs"].items():
        print("WROTE", name, path)
    return 0
if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        raise SystemExit(main())
    except Exception as e:
        print("ERROR", str(e))
        raise SystemExit(1)
